mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS couple_id, u.id AS user_id, u.name AS owner_name, u.role AS owner_role FROM couple c INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id IN (c.groom_id, c.bride_id) WHERE c.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (c.groom_id = #{userId} OR c.bride_id = #{userId}) AND u.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.id = #{userId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.id ASC

SELECT c.id AS card_id, linked_cp.id AS card_product_id, COALESCE(linked_cp.company, c.company) AS company, COALESCE(c.card_name, linked_cp.name) AS card_name, linked_cp.image AS image, COALESCE(linked_cp.annual_fee, 0) AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(linked_cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, linked_cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(linked_cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_product linked_cp ON linked_cp.id = c.card_product_id WHERE c.id = #{cardId}

SELECT NULL AS card_id, cp.id AS card_product_id, cp.company AS company, cp.name AS card_name, cp.image AS image, cp.annual_fee AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card_product cp WHERE cp.id = #{cardProductId}

SELECT NULL AS card_id, cp.id AS card_product_id, cp.company AS company, cp.name AS card_name, cp.image AS image, cp.annual_fee AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card_product cp WHERE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$.source_site')) = 'CARD_GORILLA' ORDER BY cp.updated_at DESC, cp.id DESC

SELECT NULL AS card_id, cp.id AS card_product_id, cp.company AS company, cp.name AS card_name, cp.image AS image, cp.annual_fee AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card_product cp WHERE COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$.source_site')), '') != 'CARD_GORILLA' ORDER BY cp.updated_at DESC, cp.id DESC

SELECT NULL AS card_id, cp.id AS card_product_id, cp.company AS company, cp.name AS card_name, cp.image AS image, cp.annual_fee AS annual_fee, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.benefit, '$')) AS benefit, cp.`condition` AS condition_text, DATE_FORMAT(cp.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS condition_checked_at FROM card_product cp ORDER BY cp.updated_at DESC, cp.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS card_id, c.user_id AS user_id, u.name AS owner_name, u.role AS owner_role, NULL AS card_product_id, c.company AS company, c.card_name AS card_name, 0 AS annual_fee, NULL AS image, NULL AS benefit, NULL AS condition_text, NULL AS condition_checked_at FROM card c INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.card_product_id IS NULL AND c.card_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(c.card_name) != '' ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM card cd INNER JOIN couple co ON co.status = 'CONNECTED' AND (cd.user_id = co.groom_id OR cd.user_id = co.bride_id) WHERE cd.id = #{cardId} AND (co.groom_id = #{userId} OR co.bride_id = #{userId})
SELECT cp.id FROM card_product cp WHERE cp.company = #{company} AND cp.name = #{name} ORDER BY cp.id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card_product ( company, name, annual_fee, image, benefit, `condition` ) VALUES ( #{source.company}, #{source.name}, #{source.annualFee}, #{source.image}, #{source.benefit}, #{source.conditionText} )
mapper.update: UPDATE card_product SET annual_fee = #{source.annualFee}, image = #{source.image}, benefit = #{source.benefit}, `condition` = #{source.conditionText}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE company = #{source.company} AND name = #{source.name}
